name: Hospitality
description: Hotels, restaurants, F&B POS, guest experience, and property management
rules: Guest profiles and payment tokens never land in analytics raw form
Room inventory and rate plans effective-dated across PMS and CRS
POS and PMS folio charges must reconcile nightly
Multi-property chains use property_id on every fact table
memories: Event/group blocks create inventory oversell risk — monitor pickup curves
Franchise vs managed properties may have different PMS schemas
